title: The Dust Reckoning
author: Barış Kısır
premise: Oklahoma, 1935. When the dust buries their farm a third time, the Vogel family splits: seventeen-year-old Cora joins the westbound harvest trucks, while her mother June stays to keep the land alive with a ledger of seeds and a stubborn windbreak. The reckoning comes when the two halves must choose what home means.
long_description: Cimarron County, Oklahoma, 1935-36. The third dust storm buries the Vogel farm; June stays with windbreaks and seed ledgers while Cora rides the harvest trucks west, meets the organizers, and is beaten in a strike. The Cimarron floods; Cora returns to sandbag with her mother; the family reckons with what home means.
main_characters: Cora Vogel — seventeen, stubborn, hungry for the world
June Vogel — her mother, quiet steel, rooted
Walter Vogel — father, broken by the land, gone west first
Sammy — younger brother, stays with June
